build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run sidecar

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Windows laptop power profiler and battery-forensics workbench
bundle.longDescription: power-forensics records system-wide Windows power telemetry, preserves provenance for every reading, and provides Analyze, Compare, Experiments and Calibration workspaces for battery-life forensics. The GUI is a controller; collection and forensic truth live in the bundled power-forensics engine.
